bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed and will be searched prior to entry. Non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Limited Premier parking is available to book in advance. The parking entrance is at Franklin and Congress.

rideshare.note: Use the corner of Franklin Street and Bagby Street for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Outside food and drinks are prohibited. Alcohol purchases require an original valid photo ID and age 21 or older. Pay by card or mobile payment. Cash-to-card conversion is available.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The main entrance is accessible. Request listening devices at Guest Services in the main lobby. For sign language interpretation, email 713musichallinfo@livenation.com at least two weeks before the show.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. Bring everything you need before entering.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office is inside the main lobby. It opens on show days one hour before doors. Events use mobile tickets. Bring photo ID to the box office if you need ticket help.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: The public entrance and box office are in the main venue lobby at POST Houston. Door times are event-specific; review the event listing before arrival.
